incidents.text: A yellow card for a tackle by Alistair Johnston (Canada). Facundo Tello doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
Goal! Sead Kolasinac gets up really well from the corner and heads the ball into the six-yard box where Jovo Lukic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) glances a header into the net. 0:1.
Ermedin Demirovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
Facundo Tello shows a yellow card to Jovo Lukic (Bosnia & Herzegovina), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
Luc De Fougerolles (Canada) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
Jesse Marsch has decided to make a change. Jacob Shaffelburg (Canada) replaces Liam Millar.
We are about to witness a subsitution. Promise David (Canada) for Jonathan David.
Substitution. Tajon Buchanan makes way for Ali Ahmed (Canada).
It's time for a substitution. Samed Bazdar (Bosnia & Herzegovina) comes on in place of Jovo Lukic.
Here is a change. Ivan Basic is going off and Sergej Barbarez gives the last tactical orders to Armin Gigovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina).
Substitution. Esmir Bajraktarevic will be replaced by Ivan Sunjic (Bosnia & Herzegovina).
Sergej Barbarez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Kerim Alajbegovic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) replacing Amar Memic.
The referee allows time for a substitution. Tanitoluwa Oluwaseyi will be replaced by Cyle Larin (Canada).
Goal! Promise David plays it to Cyle Larin (Canada), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Nikola Vasilj. 1:1.
Sergej Barbarez is forced to make a change. Sead Kolasinac is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Dzenis Burnic (Bosnia & Herzegovina).
Substitution. Stephen Eustaquio leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jonathan Osorio (Canada).
Nikola Katic (Bosnia & Herzegovina) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
